identity.title: [runtime-v3][ci] Give Runtime v3 an independent fast validation lane

values.goal: Make Runtime v3 path changes select a small, independent, reliable CI validation lane.
values.required_outcome: Runtime v3-only diffs run only the v3 lane; mixed diffs retain required legacy validation; unmapped v3 paths fail closed.
authority_boundary: Path-policy selection is authoritative for lane selection
Runtime v3 proof commands remain explicit argv and Rust-owned where possible
